s00-02-story-97b99b.wav.text: A witness stands up and points at a man.

s00-03-grave-321738.wav.text: Every word he says is a lie.

s00-04-story-87662b.wav.text: And because of it, an innocent man dies.

s00-05-talk-a0de30.wav.text: That really happened, in the Bible.

s00-06-grave-9d4513.wav.text: You shall not bear false witness against your neighbor.

s00-07-talk-cab627.wav.text: Most of us hear that as just don't lie.

s00-08-story-983fef.wav.text: But read it again. It's about your neighbor.

s00-09-pivot-b5f851.wav.text: It's about what your words do to someone else.

s01-01-story-d42b2f.wav.text: In ancient Israel, there were no cameras, no fingerprints, and no video.

s01-02-story-5fc99d.wav.text: Trials happened at the city gate, in front of everyone.

s01-03-story-38587f.wav.text: And every case rested on one thing: witnesses.

s01-04-talk-6341eb.wav.text: So God built in a safeguard.

s01-05-grave-86466e.wav.text: Only on the evidence of two witnesses or of three witnesses shall a charge be established.

s01-07-story-b9705e.wav.text: A lie would need a partner.

s02-01-pivot-8476de.wav.text: But even two witnesses can be bought.

s02-03-story-8b52a3.wav.text: It belonged to a man named Naboth, and he wouldn't sell it.

s02-05-story-2da132.wav.text: So Queen Jezebel wrote letters, and arranged for two worthless men to accuse him in public.

s02-06-grave-eae814.wav.text: And the worthless men brought a charge against Naboth in the presence of the people, saying,

s02-07-grave-4f2951.wav.text: Naboth cursed God and the king. It was a lie.

s02-08-story-c744c2.wav.text: And on that lie, Naboth was put to death, and the king took his vineyard.

s02-09-talk-f531a4.wav.text: The rule of two witnesses was kept.

s02-10-story-1b08a2.wav.text: The lie simply found a partner.

s03-01-talk-09c625.wav.text: That's why the commandment says against your neighbor.

s03-02-talk-cc2dac.wav.text: A false witness doesn't just bend the truth.

s03-03-story-8722f4.wav.text: He takes something. A name. A home. Sometimes a life.

s03-04-talk-a9603a.wav.text: Christians have long read this commandment as guarding your neighbor's good name.

s04-01-pivot-df5bc3.wav.text: And centuries later, it happened again.

s04-02-story-93ba15.wav.text: On the night Jesus was arrested, the leaders went looking for witnesses against him.

s04-03-grave-49a168.wav.text: For many bore false witness against him, but their testimony did not agree.

s04-04-talk-74e52f.wav.text: They couldn't even get their lies to match.

s04-05-talk-329c45.wav.text: The one who called himself the truth stood silent, while lies were told about him.

s05-01-pivot-95ed65.wav.text: We don't stand at the city gate any more.

s05-02-story-9abed5.wav.text: But the courtroom hasn't gone away.

s05-04-story-363e85.wav.text: A screenshot. A comment under a video.

s05-05-talk-caf93d.wav.text: A rumour about someone, passed on because it's interesting.

s05-06-talk-2a0b46.wav.text: I'm just saying what I heard.

s05-08-story-c7b19c.wav.text: Sometimes it's half the story, cropped to look worse.

s05-09-story-18601f.wav.text: And once it's shared, you can't take it back.

s06-01-pivot-b682e3.wav.text: So what does God want instead?

s06-02-grave-66ab05.wav.text: Therefore, having put away falsehood, let each one of you speak the truth with his neighbor,

s06-03-grave-321a50.wav.text: for we are members one of another.

s06-05-story-0d64b3.wav.text: Tear down someone's name, and you tear the body you belong to.

s06-06-talk-a4b31a.wav.text: And Paul ties that truth to love.

s06-07-grave-7ae617.wav.text: Rather, speaking the truth in love, we are to grow up in every way into him who is the head, into Christ.

s06-08-story-be0e9f.wav.text: The opposite of false witness isn't only keeping quiet.

s06-09-story-13d29e.wav.text: It's speaking up for someone when they're not in the room.

s07-01-talk-124c69.wav.text: Before you pass something on, ask yourself.

s07-02-story-ebb2d2.wav.text: Is it true? Is it fair? Would I say it to their face?

s07-04-story-abc874.wav.text: Make sure they tell the truth about your neighbor.

s07-05-pivot-a5f72a.wav.text: And remember how Naboth's story began.

s07-07-story-9d56dc.wav.text: With a king who wanted something that wasn't his.

s07-08-story-0db85e.wav.text: That's the last commandment, and it's next.
